title: Serve until separation starts healing
summary: The verse does not flatter spiritual novelty; it returns the heart to where truth can actually be kept. Let this stay near the next choice: carry this with you: stay in service and remembrance until separation begins healing.
takeaway: Do not let the search outrun shelter.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you and keep one line there.

source.shortMeaning: Steady service and remembrance begin healing long separation.
source.lifeApplication: When distance hurts, keep serving through the day and night instead of dramatizing it.
